This is a private, independent website for informational purposes only. It is not affiliated with, operated by, or endorsed by the USDA, the Food and Nutrition Administration, or any state agency. Restaurant data comes from the USDA SNAP Retailer Locator and can change — confirm with the restaurant before visiting. The Restaurant Meals Program is available only to eligible SNAP recipients (generally those who are 60+, have a disability, or are experiencing homelessness) in participating states. We never collect personal information and cannot enroll you in SNAP.
